text:
Type: small striped cotton rug with fringe
Use: softening the floor by the bed, sink or door; bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, entryway
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: flatwoven cotton, knotted fringe ends
Colors: cream base, stripes in red, navy, green, grey or pink
Shape: small rectangle, vertical pinstripes of varied widths, tasseled fringe on both short ends, flat and light
Feel: fresh, homely, casual, cheerful
Goes with: white or light wood furniture, colorful accents, tile floors; farmhouse kitchens, cottage bathrooms, Scandinavian bedrooms

product.name: SIGNE
product.description: Easy to keep clean since it is machine washable.
